body: New source-only diagnostic task. Exact A candidate b3a47443 passed all29 tests but FAILED actual same-existing-file Save As: sheet dismissed, no Replace alert, prior Saved status remains, file unchanged. Reviewer completing distinct/repeat evidence. Both e67f3f26/f20d5d88 now have failed receipts; earlier two GUI failures preserved. Do not infer cause or add another timing fix yet. Please create a separate diagnostic-only commit atop current save source adding opt-in stderr trace gated by environment TESSERA_TRACE_SAVE_AS=1. Log monotonic timestamp and request UUID at content claim, probe capture/update with window identities and parent/attached identities, finishSaveAs existence/phase, observer registration, every didEndSheet event BEFORE its guard with sheetParent/parent.attachedSheet identities, SwiftUI onDismiss, native/Swift join state, successor presentation, replacement admission and settlement. Avoid filenames/content/user paths; window identity integers and booleans suffice. No mutation of timing/lifecycle, no sleeps/polling, no broad debug infrastructure. Trace must be off by default and isolated in a diagnostic commit; A will build/run on disposable fixture and return actual event ordering before product fix. B no builds/tests/apps; paused heartbeat/resource hold unchanged. The status-policy 8488a2fb package has been accepted for A review and integrated separately into recovery; leave that and AppModel alone. Publish trace commit with scope/source review only, no acceptance claim.
